build_xcit_model: build an XCiT model using xcit_small_24_p16 for image classification with 1000 classes
create_xcit_nano_model: create a lightweight xcit_nano_12_p16 model with embed_dim 128 and 12 transformer blocks
test_xca_attention: test the Cross-Covariance Attention (XCA) module that computes attention via Q^T K cross-covariance matrix
review_class_attention_block: review the ClassAttentionBlock that applies class-token attention as in CaiT for focused representation learning
summarize_conv_patch_embed: summarize the ConvPatchEmbed module that converts images to patch embeddings using multi-layer convolutions
